test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

NO_N_ _NO_ _ON
solution:
Given : NO_N_ _NO_ _ON

By checking options :

 
• NONNN → NO__**N**__N__**O**__ __**N**__NO__**N**__ __**N**__ON → (It follows the pattern of : NON - NON - NON - NON)
 
• OOONO → NO__O__N__O__ __O__NO__N__ __O__ON → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• ONOON → NO__O__N__N__ __O__NO__O__ __N__ON → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• NONON → NO__N__N__O__ __N__NO__O__ __N__ON → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Hence, "**NONNN**" is the correct answer.
